description: Land Title Settlement Department - Radawana South, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad Map No. 511046 (24/0843)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and owner particulars. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
